name: Xperia 1

images.credit: X-SHLIED, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Predecessor: Sony Xperia XZ3, Sony Xperia XZ2 Premium

Body.Dimensions: 167 mm H, 72 mm W, 8.2 mm D
Body.Other: IP65/IP68 Water/dust resistant, PS4 Remote Play, DUALSHOCK®4 Control compatibility, Game Enhancer, Dynamic Vibration System

Platform.Operating system: Android 9 "Pie", upgradeable to Android 11, 2 OS updates, 2 years of security patches
Platform.CPU: Octa-core (1x 2.84 GHz Gold Prime, 3x 2.42 GHz Gold, 4x 1.8 GHz Silver) Kryo 485

Memory.Storage: Universal Flash Storage (UFS 2.1), 64 GB (SO-03L, SOV40 and 802SO models), 128 GB (Toshiba THGAF8T0T43BAIR; J8110, J8170, J9110 and J9150 models)

Display.Display: 6.5 in 21:9 CinemaWide™ 4K (3840 x 1644) HDR OLED, ~643 pixel density, Gorilla Glass 6, 10-bit(1.07B Colors)

Cameras.Rear camera: 12.2 MP (Sony IMX445), f/1.6, 26mm (wide), 1/2.55", 1.4 μm, predictive Dual Pixel PDAF, 5-axis OIS, 12.2 MP (Samsung ISOCELL S5K3M3), f/2.4, 52mm (telephoto), 1/3.4", 1.0 μm, predictive Dual Pixel PDAF, 2x optical zoom, 5-axis OIS, 12.2 MP (Samsung ISOCELL S5K3M3), f/2.4, 16mm (ultra-wide), 1/3.4", 1.0 μm, 4K@24/25/30fps, 1080p@30/60/960fps. 720p@960fps, HDR
Cameras.Front camera: 8 MP (Samsung ISOCELL S5K4H7), f/2.0, 24mm (wide), 1/4", 1.0 μm, 1080p@30fps (5-axis gyro-EIS)

Battery.Battery: Non-removable Li-ion 3330 mAh , rated capacity: 3200 mAh
Battery.Charging: Fast Charging USB PD 2.0 18 W Charging

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac (2.4/5 GHz), Bluetooth 5.0, USB-C, NFC, GPS with Assisted GPS, Galileo, GLONASS, BeiDou, 1seg (SO-03L, SOV40 and 802SO models only), Mobile FeliCa/Osaifu-Keitai (SO-03L, SOV40 and 802SO models only)
